# TheCheckIn

> Face recognition attendance app for Android smartphones — no biometric device, no fingerprint scanner, no extra hardware needed.

TheCheckIn is built by Pazhanam Technologies (India), a DPIIT Startup India recognised company. It is a free employee attendance tracking app that turns any Android smartphone into a face recognition attendance terminal.

## What It Does

TheCheckIn allows businesses to track employee attendance using:
- **Face recognition** with liveness detection (eye blink) — prevents proxy attendance and buddy punching
- **QR code check-in** — Branch QR (scan at office entrance) or Employee QR card (personal QR per employee)
- **GPS location validation** — for field workers, HVAC technicians, construction workers, and remote employees
- **Multi-branch management** — single admin dashboard shows attendance across all locations in real time
- **Automatic timesheets** — check-in/out data converts to daily, weekly, and monthly reports; exportable to Excel

## Key Differentiator

No biometric hardware is required. Employees use their own Android smartphone. This replaces expensive fingerprint scanners and biometric machines with a free mobile app.

## Integrations

- **ERPNext and Frappe HRMS** — face recognition attendance syncs directly into the ERPNext HR Attendance module; works with Frappe HRMS leave and payroll
- **Sage 300** — attendance timesheets export into Sage 300 Time and Attendance; replaces biometric terminal hardware for Sage 300 users
- **ERPNext customization** — Pazhanam Technologies builds custom ERPNext and Frappe modules for attendance workflows, GPS check-in, and HR process customization

## Who Uses It

Businesses of 5 to 500+ employees across industries:
- Retail and shops
- Construction and civil works
- HVAC and field service companies
- Restaurants and cafes
- Manufacturing and factories
- Clinics and healthcare
- Schools and training institutes
- Logistics and delivery

Known customers include Gibcaac (Dubai), Steconfer (global rail infrastructure), Worthybook.my (Malaysia), and Prokira Enterprise (Malaysia).

## Pricing

Free for up to 10 employees — no credit card, no hardware purchase required.
For teams larger than 10 employees, contact the team for a flexible plan.

## Platform

- **Employee app**: Android only — available on Google Play
  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pazhanam.thecheckin.attendance
- **Admin dashboard**: Web browser (any device)
  https://web.thecheckin.io/
- iOS app: not currently available
